title: Follower
description: Follower relationship record tracking which user follows another user, with follow timestamp. Used for social media platforms, follower systems, and social networking applications.

id.description: Unique identifier for the follower relationship

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user being followed

follower_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who is following

followed_at.description: Timestamp when the follow relationship was established
